acceptanceCriteria.text: Review Pages generation no longer requires an unconditional `fetch-depth: 0` checkout.
Exact event base/head SHAs are fetched and verified before generation.
OCR delegate and `diff.json` observe the same comparison semantics as before on representative fixtures/real PR runs.
Force-push, rebased head and non-trivial ancestry cases either work deterministically or fail with bounded explicit diagnostics.
No fallback silently performs a recursive/unbounded history fetch without recording why.
Existing generation/determinism tests remain green and a real PR workflow proves the optimized fetch path.

issue.title: chore: replace full-history Review Pages checkout with targeted PR revision fetch
